testName: Data Cloud Ingestion Stream & Data Model Object (DMO) Schema Mapping
steps:
1. Open Salesforce Data Cloud app
2. Navigate to Data Streams tab and open "Ingest_S3_ECommerce_Orders"
3. Verify Stream Status is "Active" with Refresh Mode "Upsert"
4. Open Data Mapping canvas
5. Verify Source DLO field "Customer_External_Id" is mapped to Individual DMO "Id"
6. Verify Source DLO field "Order_Total_Amount" is mapped to SalesOrder DMO "GrandTotalAmount"
7. Click "Validate Mappings" button and confirm zero schema mismatch warnings
